facts.heading: WHERE IT BEGAN
facts.body: United Kingdom led in 1870 with 5,829 international-$ (2011 prices) of gdp per capita - 4.8% of everything recorded that year.

facts.heading: NEW ZEALAND TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: New Zealand overtook United Kingdom in 1873 at 6,107 international-$ (2011 prices).

facts.heading: AUSTRALIA TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: Australia overtook New Zealand in 1875 at 6,596 international-$ (2011 prices).
